facts.fact: SOSUP launched a national operation to identify schools and assign each learner a unique national identifier (INA), collecting school and pupil files through provincial and zonal academic delegates to centralise school data, per Le Journal des Lycées.
facts.system: Opération Nationale d'Identification des Établissements et des Apprenants (INA)

GAB.note: Data capture is by files sent up through delegates; no school-level routine entry or live system stated.
